test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**The given sentence is in active voice. Change the voice of the sentence. Select the correct option from the sentences given in options.**

Pranav painted his house.

options.text: The house had been painted by Pranav.
Pranav's house was painted by him.
Painting of the house was done by Pranav.
House painting was done by Pranav.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Pranav's house was painted by him.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in active voice. As per the question we have to change it into passive voice.
 
• The format of Active voice is: **Subject + V2 + Object**.
 
• Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: **Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case)**.
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *She built a large garden. (Active voice)*
 
• *A large garden was built by her. (Passive voice)*
 
 
 
• Correct sentence - **Pranav's house was painted by him.**
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
